children.name: Ancistrocladus abbreviatus Airy Shaw
children.description: The native range of this species is W. Trop. Africa to Cameroon. It is a climber and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Ancistrocladus attenuatus Dyer
children.description: The native range of this species is India (West Bengal), Andaman Is., Myanmar. It is a climber and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Ancistrocladus barteri Scott Elliot
children.description: The native range of this species is W. Trop. Africa. It is a climber and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Ancistrocladus congolensis J.Léonard
children.description: The native range of this species is Gabon to C. DR Congo. It is a liana and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Ancistrocladus ealaensis J.Léonard
children.description: The native range of this species is SW. Central African Rep. to NW. DR Congo. It is a liana and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Ancistrocladus grandiflorus Cheek
children.description: The native range of this species is SW. Cameroon. It is a climber and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Ancistrocladus griffithii Planch.
children.description: The native range of this species is Indo-China. It is a climber and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Ancistrocladus guineensis Oliv.
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. Nigeria to Gabon. It is a climber and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Ancistrocladus hamatus  Gilg
children.description: The native range of this species is Sri Lanka. It is a climbing shrub and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Ancistrocladus heyneanus Wall.
children.description: Ancistrocladus heyneanus or kardal is a liana endemic to the Western Ghats of southwestern India.

children.name: Ancistrocladus ileboensis Heubl, Mudogo & G.Bringmann
children.description: The native range of this species is Congo. It is a climber and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Ancistrocladus korupensis D.W.Thomas & Gereau
children.description: Ancistrocladus korupensis is a species of liana endemic to southwestern Cameroon and the neighbouring regions of Nigeria.

children.name: Ancistrocladus letestui Pellegr.
children.description: Ancistrocladus letestui is a species of liana of the plant family of the Ancistrocladaceae occurring in the subtropical or tropical dry forests of Cameroon, Congo-Brazzaville, Zaire, and Gabon.

children.name: Ancistrocladus likoko J.Léonard
children.description: The native range of this species is Congo to W. & C. DR Congo. It is a climber and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Ancistrocladus robertsoniorum J.Léonard
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. Kenya (Kwale Distr.). It is a climber and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Ancistrocladus tanzaniensis Cheek & Frimodt-Møller
children.description: The native range of this species is Tanzania (Uzungwa Mts.). It is a climber and grows primarily in the seasonally dry tropical biome.

children.name: Ancistrocladus wallichii Planch.
children.description: The native range of this species is Assam to Myanmar, Andaman Is.. It is a climber and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.
